items.title: Add Codex adapter doctor diagnostics
items.context: Extend the Codex wrapper/doctor path so users can run a Codex-focused health check for manifest drift, wrapper/fallback health, excluded runtime assets, agents mirror, source/session behavior, and aux availability.
items.userSees: Terminal shows "Codex adapter doctor" followed by "Status: PASS" for healthy projects, or "Status: FAIL" with repair commands such as "koala init --verify-codex" when Codex assets drift.

happy.desc: Codex doctor reports PASS for a healthy local adapter with .Codex/koala.json and no fake hooks/settings

edge.desc: Codex doctor warns or fails with actionable guidance when global fallback/read-only heartbeat or aux availability is missing

adversarial.desc: Codex doctor detects unsupported .Codex/hooks or .Codex/settings.json if they appear

verificationEvidence.note: Doctor Codex adapter scan passed 7/7 on healthy repo, including manifest and runtime exclusions.
Doctor now reports wrapper/fallback heartbeat and aux availability with actionable command hints when not executed or failing.
Codex asset verification asserts .Codex/hooks and .Codex/settings.json are absent and manifest matches template.

items.title: Record Codex process-events and role telemetry
items.context: Hard-code structured Codex activity events so session_brief can stop guessing who did what. Capture source, session, role, storyId, phase, command, entrypoint and result for wrapper/global Codex calls.
items.userSees: After running "KOALA_ACTIVITY_ROLE=reviewer node bin/koala-codex.js session_brief", event output includes "source=codex", "role=reviewer", "command=session_brief", and "result=ok" for the current session.

happy.desc: Codex wrapper command writes a structured process event with source=codex, command, storyId or active story, phase, and result

edge.desc: Telemetry derives session from CODEX_SESSION_ID, OPENAI_SESSION_ID, TERM_SESSION_ID, or KOALA_ACTIVITY_SESSION consistently

adversarial.desc: Reviewer pass/finding commands without agent attribution are rejected or hard-warned so they cannot silently become main-agent records

verificationEvidence.note: Entrypoint verification asserts Codex wrapper writes source=codex activity and codex_cli process-event with command/story/phase/result context.
Entrypoint verification covers CODEX_SESSION_ID propagation through bin/koala-codex.js into activity/session telemetry.
packages/main/src/handlers/finding.ts records a hard warning process-event when finding_add lacks agent attribution, while review_pass_set remains hard-enforced.

items.title: Add scriptable Codex init verification
items.context: Expose a hard verification path, either koala verify_codex and koala init --verify-codex sharing the same implementation, that validates generated Codex assets, wrapper heartbeat, fallback heartbeat, agents mirror, and absence of fake runtime assets.
items.userSees: Running "koala verify_codex" prints "Codex adapter verification PASS" with rows for manifest, agents mirror, local wrapper, global fallback heartbeat, and excluded runtime assets; "koala init --verify-codex" prints the same verification after init.

happy.desc: koala verify_codex passes on the repository Codex adapter and validates manifest, agents, wrapper, fallback, and exclusions

edge.desc: koala init --verify-codex generates assets then runs the same verification logic

adversarial.desc: verification fails if .Codex/koala.json drifts or .Codex/hooks/.Codex/settings.json are created

verificationEvidence.note: Local-bootstrap koala verify_codex passed 7/7 checks for manifest, agents, wrapper heartbeat, fallback heartbeat, exclusions, and aux availability.
Temp-project koala init --verify-codex passed using the same shared checks after generating Codex assets and wrapper.
Shared Codex asset verifier fails on manifest drift or forbidden runtime assets; current run passed with exclusions enforced.

items.title: Document Codex hard capabilities only after implementation
items.context: Update README, AGENTS, and .Codex/README so they describe doctor, telemetry, and verify_codex as actual hard CLI behavior, not aspirational prompt instructions.
items.userSees: README, AGENTS, and .Codex/README show exact commands: "node bin/koala-codex.js doctor", "koala verify_codex", and "koala init --verify-codex", and state ".Codex/hooks" / ".Codex/settings.json" are not Codex runtime assets.

happy.desc: Docs list node bin/koala-codex.js doctor and koala verify_codex/koala init --verify-codex with accurate behavior

edge.desc: Docs distinguish doctor diagnostics from verify_codex scriptable validation without duplicating contradictory guidance

adversarial.desc: Docs do not imply prompt-only compliance or fake Codex runtime hooks/settings

verificationEvidence.note: README.md, AGENTS.md, .Codex/README.md, and init template document doctor, verify_codex, init --verify-codex, heartbeat evidence, and exclusions.
Docs distinguish npm run test:codex-assets drift checks from koala verify_codex heartbeat/evidence checks.
Docs and manifest continue to say Codex does not use fake .Codex/hooks or .Codex/settings.json runtime assets.

items.title: Make REVIEW and DONE gates consume Codex hard evidence
items.context: Close the scope gap from koala-review-scope-plan: doctor, verify_codex, and role telemetry should not only exist; REVIEW/DONE checks must consume their machine-readable evidence so Codex adapter health becomes a gateable fact.
items.userSees: DONE pre-check output includes "Codex hard evidence: PASS" when doctor/verify/telemetry evidence is fresh, and prints "Codex hard evidence: missing" with "koala verify_codex" when it is absent or stale.

happy.desc: REVIEW or DONE preflight can read Codex verify/doctor evidence and report it as a passing gate input

edge.desc: Gate output distinguishes missing Codex evidence from failing Codex evidence with actionable commands

adversarial.desc: DONE cannot pass on prompt-only Codex compliance when required Codex hard evidence is absent or stale

verificationEvidence.note: packages/main/src/handlers/review-preflight.ts and story-advance.ts consume codex_adapter_verification evidence as passing gate input.
summarizeCodexEvidence distinguishes not-required, missing, failing, and passing states with koala verify_codex as the actionable command.
DONE checklist adds a hard Codex adapter evidence row for Codex-touching stories, blocking prompt-only compliance when evidence is missing or failing.
